=== FILE: irq_ctrl_vplan.yaml ===
# Verification plan: irq_ctrl
# Serves requirement req-5fc7831312: Verify the existing interrupt controller RTL.
# Source specification: interface_spec.md (approved interface_spec).
# This plan states what will be verified and how. It records no results.
# Parameter sweep: every test and assertion item is planned at N = 2, 8 and 32.

block: irq_ctrl

requirements:
  - id: IRQ-PARAM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."
  - id: IRQ-RESET
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."
  - id: IRQ-REG-RW
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."
  - id: IRQ-READ
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."
  - id: IRQ-LEVEL
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."
  - id: IRQ-EDGE
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."
  - id: IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."
  - id: IRQ-W1C
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."
  - id: IRQ-ACK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."
  - id: IRQ-SET-WINS
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."
  - id: IRQ-MASK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."
  - id: IRQ-PRIORITY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."
  - id: IRQ-CLAIM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."
  - id: IRQ-LATENCY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."

items:
  # ---------------- Directed and random tests (simulation) ----------------
  - id: t_smoke
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET, IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Smoke test. Stimulus: reset, enable source 0 as level, drive src[0] high, read CLAIM, write CLAIM with 0, drop src[0]. Check: irq rises, CLAIM reads 0x8000_0000 with id 0, PENDING clears after the acknowledge, irq falls."

  - id: t_param_sweep
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Build and run at N=2, 8 and 32. Stimulus: write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, and drive every src bit. Check: ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read zero in bits N and up, and bits N-1..0 behave per the scoreboard."

  - id: t_reset_values
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET]
    description: "Stimulus: put nonzero values in ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, hold rising-edge sources high, then assert rst_n low for one or more edges. Check: all three registers read zero. Release reset with an edge-mode source still high; check that the source then sets PENDING once, showing the remembered level was cleared to zero."

  - id: t_reg_rw
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Stimulus: write random, walking-one and all-ones patterns to ENABLE and MODE. Check: read-back equals wdata[N-1:0], upper bits read zero, and the other register is unchanged."

  - id: t_read_side_effects
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ]
    description: "Stimulus: sweep addr over 0..3 with we low over many cycles, including CLAIM while irq is high, and change addr between edges. Check: no register changes. rdata matches the selected register in the same cycle, sampled before the next edge."

  - id: t_level_detect
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL]
    description: "Stimulus: level-mode source held high across several edges, cleared by W1C between edges. Check: PENDING is set again at every edge where the input is high."

  - id: t_edge_detect
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-EDGE]
    description: "Stimulus: edge-mode source with a single-cycle pulse, an input held high for many cycles with a W1C clear in the middle, and back-to-back toggles. Check: PENDING is set only on a low-to-high transition between consecutive edges, and is not set again while the input stays high."

  - id: t_mode_switch
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-LEVEL]
    description: "Stimulus: change MODE bits while sources are high. Check: detection follows the new mode from the write edge onward, per the scoreboard model."

  - id: t_detect_disabled
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Stimulus: ENABLE zero, drive level and edge sources. Check: PENDING bits set while irq stays low. Then enable the sources; check that irq rises with no new source activity."

  - id: t_w1c
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C]
    description: "Stimulus: set several PENDING bits with sources then low, and write random masks to PENDING, including bits that are already zero. Check: written-1 bits clear, written-0 bits keep their value, and no zero bit becomes one."

  - id: t_ack
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-ACK]
    description: "Stimulus: set all PENDING bits with sources low, then write CLAIM with every id 0..31 and with garbage in wdata[31:5]. Check: only bit wdata[4:0] clears, ids >= N change nothing, and wdata upper bits are ignored."

  - id: t_set_wins
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Stimulus: at the same edge as a PENDING W1C write or a CLAIM acknowledge, a level source is high, or an edge source has a rising edge. Check: the bit stays set after that edge. A level source acknowledged while still high stays pending and irq stays high."

  - id: t_priority
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Stimulus: random PENDING and ENABLE combinations, plus a claim-and-acknowledge loop that services all sources. Check: irq_id is the lowest index with PENDING and ENABLE both set, sources are serviced in ascending order, and irq_id is 0 whenever irq is low."

  - id: t_claim_read
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Stimulus: read CLAIM with irq low and high, for ids 0, N-1 and random. Check: bit 31 equals irq, bits 4..0 equal irq_id, and bits 30..5 are zero."

  - id: t_random_scoreboard
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK, IRQ-SET-WINS, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "Constrained-random src, register writes and reads at N=2, 8 and 32. A cycle-accurate reference model predicts ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, and the remembered level. Check: every rdata, irq and irq_id value is compared each cycle, before and after each edge."

  # ---------------- Assertions (formal, also bound in simulation) ----------------
  - id: a_upper_bits_zero
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "For addr 0..2, rdata[31:N] is always zero. Run formal at N=2, 8 and 32."

  - id: a_reset_clears
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET]
    description: "If rst_n is low at an edge, then ENABLE, MODE, PENDING and the remembered source level are zero after that edge."

  - id: a_read_no_change
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ]
    description: "If we is low, src activity cannot alter ENABLE or MODE, and PENDING only gains bits from detection. Also, rdata equals the register that addr selects, combinationally."

  - id: a_pending_next
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK, IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Per bit i: next PENDING[i] = detect[i] | (PENDING[i] & ~clear[i]). Here detect is src[i] for level mode, and src[i] & ~prev[i] for edge mode. clear is the W1C mask or the acknowledge decode, the latter only for ids < N. ENABLE does not appear in the term."

  - id: a_no_set_by_write
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C]
    description: "A PENDING bit rises only when detect is true for that bit, never because of a write."

  - id: a_irq_mask
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-MASK, IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE), checked combinationally at all times."

  - id: a_irq_id
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "irq_id equals the lowest set index of PENDING & ENABLE, and irq_id == 0 when irq is low. Checked combinationally."

  - id: a_claim_format
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "When addr == 3: rdata[31] == irq, rdata[4:0] == irq_id, and rdata[30:5] == 0."

  - id: a_regs_stable_without_write
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-READ]
    description: "ENABLE and MODE change only at an edge with we high and addr 0 or 1, and then take wdata[N-1:0]."

  # ---------------- Coverage points (measured on the design) ----------------
  - id: c_param_n
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Coverage collected separately at N=2, 8 and 32. Toggle coverage of all ENABLE, MODE and PENDING bits."

  - id: c_mode_x_detect
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED]
    description: "Cross of MODE bit (level/edge), ENABLE bit (0/1) and detect event per source, plus edge source held high for more than one edge."

  - id: c_clear_paths
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK]
    description: "W1C with mixed 1/0 masks. Acknowledge for every id in 0..N-1, and acknowledge with id >= N."

  - id: c_set_wins
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Detect and clear on the same bit at the same edge, for both W1C and acknowledge, and for both modes."

  - id: c_priority
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-MASK]
    description: "irq_id hits every value 0..N-1. Multiple candidates are active when the winner is chosen. A pending but disabled lower source sits under an enabled higher source."

  - id: c_reg_access
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-READ, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Reads and writes to each of addr 0..3, and CLAIM reads with irq high and low."

  - id: c_reset_activity
    kind: coverage_point
    file: irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET, IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "Reset asserted while registers are nonzero and while edge sources are high. irq rises in the cycle right after a detect edge."
=== END FILE ===
